_schema: OT known-issues registry. Each entry annotates a (model_eid, signal) so the fleet-health renderer can mark a finding KNOWN (owner already on it) instead of re-alerting it as new. Entries EXPIRE: past 'expires', a still-present finding re-surfaces LOUDLY for re-triage (a 2-week issue that persists may be a different/escalated problem). Operator-curated (trustworthy suppression); bot may propose. signal ∈ zombie|training-age|qps_down|* (* = any). Edit via tools/add-known-issue.sh.
